label: 圆冠盆
summary: a soft round crown; set down, the crown sags into a round basin: a flat floor and a rounded wall up to the brim, no steps and no corners

worn.note: outer radius crown_base*(1-t)^power over the height; from t=droop.from the tip leans over to +x and hangs (the soft bent tip)

afloat.note: hat units below the brim face that sat on the head; the wall is a quarter ellipse from the opening (vertical at the brim) to the floor (level), the upper crown lies flat on the floor as concentric rings; the pressed tip leaves a shallow dimple
